name: Gram Panchayat Road Asphalting
description: Comprehensive road repair and asphalting for the main village approach road connecting to the state highway. This will facilitate easier transport for agricultural produce.

name: Village Lake Rejuvenation (Kere)
description: De-silting and strengthening the embankments of the village lake to improve water table levels and provide sustainable irrigation for local farmers.

name: Borewell Installation & Pipeline
description: Drilling three new high-yield borewells and laying 2km of pipeline to ensure 24/7 drinking water supply to the SC/ST colony and surrounding houses.

name: Government School Smart Classroom
description: Renovating the primary school building and installing digital smart boards and high-speed internet to modernize rural education for village children.

name: Community Toilet Block (Swachh Bharat)
description: Construction of separate toilet blocks for men and women in the village marketplace to maintain hygiene and achieve 100% open-defecation-free status.

name: Anganwadi Building Construction
description: Building a new Anganwadi center with a dedicated kitchen and play area to ensure better nutrition and early education for village toddlers.
